method_contract.rule: Aedifica must not hardcode paid SIA coefficients; it accepts office-provided factors and logs assumptions.

assumptions: Hourly model used because paid SIA coefficients are not embedded in the pilot.
Scope is limited to phase 33 permit coordination for the demo parcel.
exclusions: Specialist engineering fees (structure, MEP) are excluded from the architect fee.
Authority emoluments and notary costs are excluded.
